verdict.rationale: Grafana documents connecting AI agents through a hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open-source MCP Server (grafana-docs-7, grafana-probe-4), and a probe found a published OpenAPI spec (grafana-probe-3). The platform is documented to query metrics, logs, and traces across data sources (grafana-docs-9, grafana-docs-15, grafana-docs-4), so an external agent has documented programmatic paths to debug production. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP or API tools cover querying all three signals (PromQL, LogQL, and trace search), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging via these interfaces.
